vocabulary.EXACT_ON_EVENT: Exact maximum of the certificate objective over the stated event (exhaustive or count-feasible assignment).
vocabulary.VALID_UPPER_BOUND: Proved upper bound on the exact objective over the same event; may be loose.
vocabulary.BASELINE_UPPER_BOUND: Separate-competitor (strong) baseline; valid upper bound, used for comparison only.
vocabulary.KNOWN_INVALID: Can return a value below a feasible objective. Must not certify.
vocabulary.CLOSED: Entry point raises, so any call fails loudly.

union_C_box / direct_C_box.role: coupled certificate: one competitor, one assignment

union_C_box_plus.event: box intersected with nonnegative count feasibility (E_plus)

union_C_strong / direct_C_strong.role: min(C_sep, C_rank, C_pair, C_block5) at auxiliary t_s plus delta_s once; identical to C_box for k<=5

*_plus_raw relaxations.role: upper bounds on C_box_plus; not monotone in the event

certificate_mswap_os.role: stratified m-swap; default call raises TopKCertError; unsafe=True only reproduces the defect
certificate_mswap_os.evidence: k=9 reordering witness and psi_m witness (tests/test_os_validity.py, tests/test_os_audit.py)

decision_rule: Certify iff C/S <= tau with S = max(U(Y+), 1e-6); no additive slack; never take a minimum across events.
